tasks.label: Find a policy
tasks.action: Search source catalogue; inspect captured edition/currency separately
tasks.result: Source identity and dated provenance; authority may remain unconfirmed

tasks.label: Open a case
tasks.action: Open the existing case or native New form; retain existing identity rules
tasks.result: Case context, action and source/draft links; no assignment inferred

tasks.label: Prepare a package — download/manual
tasks.action: Download HTML assembler; open locally and create a new DRAFT ZIP
tasks.result: Completeness report and new DRAFT output; no submission

tasks.label: Record a review
tasks.input: Actual finding, exact CaseUID/document/version/hash and evidence
tasks.action: Use native readiness/assurance records; leave unassessed values pending
tasks.result: Version-specific human finding, not policy approval

tasks.label: Resolve an exception — guided operator steps
tasks.input: Held identity evidence or missing action/evidence
tasks.action: Use existing resolution tool and sole importer; inspect focused views
tasks.result: Explicit resolution or visible hold, never an invented identity

datePolicy: Strict real YYYY-MM-DD dates only; past is relative to Australia/Brisbane. ISO text alone never proves agreement; conditions/pending/invalid values are not overdue.
sourceLinkPolicy: Clickable recorded source/draft links restricted to the bound workspace site; other references remain visible text for manual verification.
